items.title: CIO sees Walmart results as key test of US consumer spending
items.summary:
STORY: "Walmart will be the tell on whether the U.S. consumer is pulling back."

Coons said recent results from TJ Maxx and Target offer conflicting signals on the health of the U.S. consumer, with TJ Maxx reflecting demand for value among price-sensitive shoppers and Target's performance more closely tied to its turnaround efforts and higher-income customers.

He added that Walmart, with its broad customer base, may offer a more reliable read on whether spending is slowing across the economy.
